announcements.title: Uji Sertifikasi Kompetensi Ahli K3 Listrik BNSP 2026
announcements.titleEn: BNSP Electrical Safety (K3) Expert Certification Exam 2026
announcements.content: Pendaftaran uji sertifikasi kompetensi skema Pemasangan Instalasi Penerangan dan Ahli K3 Listrik dibuka untuk mahasiswa Semester 6 & 8. Kuota subsidi terbatas 50 peserta. Hubungi Kaprodi D4 Teknik Listrik.
announcements.contentEn: Registration for BNSP Electrical Installation and K3 Certification is now open for Semesters 6 & 8 students. Subsidized quota limited to 50 participants. Contact D4 Program Coordinator.

announcements.title: Jadwal Ujian Tengah Semester (UTS) Praktikum Ganjil
announcements.titleEn: Midterm Practicum Exam (UTS) Schedule - Odd Semester
announcements.content: Seluruh praktikan wajib menyelesaikan laporan sementara dan lembar asistensi minimal 80% sebelum mengikuti ujian praktikum. Dilarang membawa barang yang tidak berkepentingan ke ruang lab.
announcements.contentEn: All students must complete temporary reports and lab worksheets at least 80% before taking practical exams. Unauthorized items in the lab are prohibited.

announcements.title: SOP Wajib: Pemakaian Alat Pelindung Diri (APD) di Area Lab
announcements.titleEn: Mandatory SOP: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) in Lab Area
announcements.content: Setiap mahasiswa dan asisten yang memasuki Lab Instalasi Tenaga WAJIB mengenakan Sepatu Safety (Safety Shoes), Jas Lab Katun Anti-Statik, dan tidak mengenakan perhiasan logam penghantar listrik.
announcements.contentEn: Every student and assistant entering the Power Installation Lab MUST wear Safety Shoes, Anti-Static Cotton Lab Coats, and remove metallic conductive jewelry.

announcements.title: Workshop Industrial IoT & PLC Omron Bersama PT Schneider Electric
announcements.titleEn: Industrial IoT & Omron PLC Workshop with PT Schneider Electric
announcements.content: Pusat Studi Otomasi POLIMDO mengadakan pelatihan hands-on PLC SCADA berbasis Cloud dengan sertifikat internasional. Tempat di Lab Otomasi D4.
announcements.contentEn: POLIMDO Automation Study Center is holding hands-on Cloud-based PLC SCADA training with international certificates at the D4 Automation Lab.
